description: This line plot illustrates the progression of next-token prediction accuracy for two experimental conditions, labeled “Ex1 Accuracy” and “Ex2 Accuracy,” over training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to 600,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 100,000, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” ranges from 0.10 to 0.40 with tick marks at 0.05 intervals, also on a linear scale. The “Ex1 Accuracy” line, rendered in dark blue with circular markers and a solid line, begins near 0.23 at step 0, rises sharply to approximately 0.39 by step 50,000, then continues to climb gradually, reaching about 0.41 by step 600,000. The “Ex2 Accuracy” line, shown in teal with circular markers and a solid line, starts at approximately 0.09 at step 0, jumps to around 0.27 by step 50,000, then increases more slowly, reaching approximately 0.38 by step 600,000. Both lines exhibit a steep initial rise followed by a slower, steady increase, with Ex1 consistently outperforming Ex2 across all steps shown.
